item.title: As missiles light the sky, she boards a one-way flight to Dubai
item.summary: American hairstylist Rikki Dimitriadis moved from Miami to Dubai amid Iran-UAE conflict and says she has no regrets, calling the decision a no-brainer.

item.title: Iran's supreme leader severely disfigured by US strikes: report
item.summary: Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei is severely disfigured after U.S.-Israel airstrikes on Tehran killed his father, according to a Reuters report citing anonymous sources.

item.title: Man climbs onto US military aircraft in Ireland, attacks it with hatchet: report
item.summary: A man allegedly climbed onto a U.S. military aircraft at Ireland's Shannon Airport and attacked it with a hatchet, according to local police reports.

item.title: House Republican plans motion to oust Swalwell from Congress amid sexual assault allegations
item.summary: Rep. Anna Paulina Luna files motion to expel Rep. Eric Swalwell from Congress amid accusations of sexual assault from at least four former female staffers in his office.

item.title: Machete-wielding suspect claiming to be 'Lucifer' shot by police after allegedly stabbing 3 at transit hub
item.summary: A machete-wielding man claiming to be Lucifer attacked three people at Grand Central Terminal before NYPD officers fatally shot him, police say.

item.title: ‘Charlie’s Angels’ star Cheryl Ladd defied producers with ‘tiniest bikini ever’ to make her point
item.summary: Cheryl Ladd says she bought the tiniest bikini to defy producer Aaron Spelling's wardrobe choices on the set of the iconic series "Charlie's Angels."

item.title: Americans wait overnight for access to free healthcare as costs soar ‘out of reach’
item.summary: Some Americans are sleeping in their cars for days to receive free healthcare from Remote Area Medical's volunteer pop-up clinics across the country. CEO Chris Hall shares details.

item.title: 'Peaky Blinders' star Tom Hardy spotted enjoying beach day in Barbados with wife during family vacation
item.summary: Tom Hardy was photographed enjoying a beach vacation in Barbados with wife Charlotte Riley, taking a dip in the ocean and soaking up the sun.

item.title: Samsung Messages ending? What Android owners must know
item.summary: Samsung is phasing out Samsung Messages by July 2026 in the U.S. and pushing Google Messages, but scam texts are targeting confused Galaxy phone owners.

item.title: Dem senator calls out far-left streamer, asks what 'normal' person would go on such an antagonistic show
item.summary: Sen. Elissa Slotkin fired back at Hasan Piker, citing his derogatory remarks about orthodox Jews and his prior suggestion that America deserved 9/11.
